source.citation: BLS Current Population Survey, Table 3, 'Employment status of the civilian noninstitutional population by age, sex, and race', household data annual averages, total (all races), civilian labor force and unemployed in thousands. https://www.bls.gov/cps/cpsaat03.htm

note: Each band's unemployment rate against the overall rate is the band's ratio; a place's own rate scales it. The 16-to-19 row covers the opening's youngest working-age band (18 and 19).
